governance.scope: source research only; no repository edits, no solver run, no production activation
governance.decision_rule: An exact official reaction or a cross-linked official pH-7.3 reaction is required. Name similarity and algebraic coupling alone do not authorize an identity or proton edit.
governance.canonical_h_coefficient_definition: Signed H+ stoichiometric coefficient in the model-written direction: positive for product, negative for reactant.
governance.human_gate: All proposed tuple and H+ changes remain candidates and require atomic all-copy closure plus explicit human approval.

reactions.required_change: Candidate: add one H+ reactant, only in the same atomic transaction that normalizes all NAD+/NADH copies to the Rhea pH-7.3 tuples.
reactions.limitations: The model NAD(H) tuples are legacy neutral species; the H+ edit alone would not be source-closed.

reactions.source_equation: palmitoyl-CoA + oxygen + NADH --> 2 H2O + NAD + palmitoleoyl-CoA
reactions.required_change: None authorized. Resolve both C16 delta-9 substrate specificity and the explicit NADH-to-cytochrome-b5 coupling before assigning a canonical H+ coefficient.
reactions.limitations: IUBMB EC 1.14.19.1 and RHEA:19721 specify octadecanoyl-CoA with reduced cytochrome b5, not this C16 NADH-lumped equation. Formal coupling would predict one H+ reactant, but that is an inference, not an official same-reaction record.

reactions.source_equation: stearoyl-CoA + oxygen + NADH --> 2 H2O + NAD + oleoyl-CoA
reactions.required_change: None authorized. Source-close the cytochrome-b5 reductase coupling as an explicit documented lump or retain the carrier-mediated official chemistry.
reactions.limitations: The substrate/product pair is supported, but official Rhea/IUBMB chemistry uses 2 reduced cytochrome b5 and 2 H+, not NADH directly. Formal pathway summation predicts one H+ reactant but cannot substitute for a same-reaction source.

reactions.candidate_identity: no official match for the current (3R)+NAD+ cofactor/stereochemistry pairing
reactions.required_change: None authorized. Choose and evidence either (3S)+NAD+ or (3R)+NADP+; do not repair the current hybrid with H+ alone.
reactions.limitations: RHEA:30799/KEGG R01975 pair (3S) with NAD+, while RHEA:45796/KEGG R01977 pair (3R) with NADP+. Both official alternatives produce H+, but neither is the current reaction.

reactions.source_equation: NAD + 2 H+ + 2-oxoadipic acid + CoA --> glutaryl-CoA + NADH + CO2
reactions.required_change: Candidate: remove both reactant H+ coefficients while atomically normalizing NAD(H), CoA, glutaryl-CoA, and 2-oxoadipate tuples.
reactions.limitations: KEGG R01933 writes one product H+ under its legacy compound convention; Rhea pH-7.3 major microspecies chemistry has no explicit H+ and controls the canonical coefficient here.

reactions.required_change: Candidate: add two product H+ and change 4-aminobutanal to the Rhea cation tuple, together with all NAD(H) copy updates.
reactions.limitations: The model aldehyde is unannotated C4H9NO/charge 0; Rhea uses CHEBI:58264 C4H10NO/charge +1. KEGG's one-H form reflects a different protonation convention.

reactions.required_change: Candidate: add one product H+ with NAD(H) tuple migration and explicitly map model D-fructose to the keto-D-fructose reaction participant.
reactions.limitations: KEGG C00095 supports the broad D-fructose identity; Rhea uses keto-D-fructose CHEBI:48095, whereas the model carries CHEBI:37721, so tautomer scope must be declared.

reactions.source_equation: H2O + NAD + L-4-hydroxyglutamate semialdehyde <=> NADH + erythro-4-hydroxy-L-glutamic acid
reactions.candidate_identity: L-4-hydroxyglutamate semialdehyde + NAD+ + H2O <=> (4S)-4-hydroxy-L-glutamate + NADH + 2 H+
reactions.required_change: Candidate: add two product H+ and atomically migrate product, semialdehyde, and NAD(H) tuples.
reactions.limitations: The model product is neutral C5H9NO5; Rhea uses (4S)-4-hydroxy-L-glutamate C5H8NO5/charge -1. KEGG's reverse equation has one H+ because of its compound convention.

reactions.required_change: Candidate: add one product H+ in the same atomic transaction as malate, oxaloacetate, and NAD(H) pH-7.3 tuple normalization.
reactions.limitations: The model currently uses neutral malic acid/oxaloacetic acid tuples despite anion xrefs.

reactions.required_change: Candidate: reduce the product H+ coefficient from 2 to 1 with NAD+ tuple normalization; retain ADP-D-ribose stereochemical identity.
reactions.limitations: MetaNetX MNXR145763 is deprecated to MNXR145761. KEGG omits H+ under its legacy convention; Rhea pH-7.3 controls the coefficient.

reactions.required_change: Candidate: add one product H+ only with atomic ATP/ADP/NADH/NADPH tuple migration.
reactions.limitations: All four nucleotide/cofactor tuples are legacy neutral species in the model.

reactions.required_change: No H+ edit. Candidate requires 3-demethylubiquinone-9 as the pH-7.3 anion and NAD(H) normalization; replace stale EC metadata only through curated review.
reactions.limitations: Rhea product is charge -1/C53H79O4, while model m611 is neutral C53H80O4. The model's EC list does not contain the current official EC 1.14.13.253.

reactions.source_equation: CoA + ATP + palmitoleate --> AMP + PPi + palmitoleoyl-CoA
reactions.required_change: No H+ edit. Atomically migrate palmitoleate from neutral acid to (9Z)-hexadecenoate charge -1 and normalize CoA, ATP, AMP, diphosphate, and acyl-CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: The model palmitoleate tuple is neutral C16H30O2; the official reaction uses CHEBI:32372 C16H29O2/charge -1.

reactions.source_equation: CoA + ATP + oleate --> AMP + PPi + oleoyl-CoA
reactions.required_change: No H+ edit. Atomically migrate oleate to (9Z)-octadecenoate charge -1 and normalize all CoA/nucleotide/acyl-CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: The model oleate tuple is neutral C18H34O2 and oleoyl-CoA lacks a direct ChEBI xref; exact structural xrefs must be closed across copies.

reactions.required_change: No H+ edit; retain +1 product H+ while atomically normalizing butanoyl-CoA and CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: Model butanoate is already the charge -1 species, but the CoA-family tuples remain legacy neutral species.

reactions.required_change: No H+ edit; retain +1 product H+ while atomically normalizing hexanoyl-CoA and CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: Model hexanoate is already the charge -1 species, but the CoA-family tuples remain legacy neutral species.

reactions.required_change: Candidate: add one product H+ and atomically migrate neutral palmitoleic acid to (9Z)-hexadecenoate plus CoA/acyl-CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: The substrate-specific Rhea record closes the former search gap; no inference from the generic hydrolase alone is needed.

reactions.required_change: Candidate: add one product H+ and atomically migrate neutral oleic acid to (9Z)-octadecenoate plus CoA/acyl-CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: KEGG R08176 omits H+ under its compound convention; Rhea pH-7.3 chemistry explicitly produces H+.

reactions.source_equation: H+ + butyrate + CoA + ATP --> butanoyl-CoA + AMP + PPi
reactions.candidate_identity: butanoate + ATP + CoA <=> butanoyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate
reactions.required_change: Candidate: remove the reactant H+ while atomically normalizing CoA, ATP, AMP, diphosphate, and butanoyl-CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: Butanoate is already charge -1; the extra H+ compensates legacy neutral cofactor/acyl-CoA tuples and must not be removed in isolation.

reactions.source_equation: H+ + hexanoate + CoA + ATP --> hexanoyl-CoA + AMP + PPi
reactions.candidate_identity: hexanoate + ATP + CoA => hexanoyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate
reactions.required_change: Candidate: remove the reactant H+ while atomically normalizing CoA, ATP, AMP, diphosphate, and hexanoyl-CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: Hexanoate is already charge -1; the H+ edit is valid only with all shared cofactor and acyl-CoA copies closed.

reactions.source_equation: CoA + ATP + laurate --> lauroyl-CoA + AMP + PPi
reactions.candidate_identity: dodecanoate + ATP + CoA => dodecanoyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate
reactions.required_change: No H+ edit. Atomically migrate neutral lauric acid to dodecanoate charge -1 and normalize CoA/nucleotide/lauroyl-CoA tuples.
reactions.limitations: The model laurate tuple is neutral C12H24O2; official Rhea uses dodecanoate.

r364.required_change: No H+ edit. Do not add m586->C02051 alone. First normalize both m586 and m588 to one explicit conserved-protein-moiety schema, prove identical carrier scope across incident reactions, and then update all copies atomically.
r364.limitations: Official sources close the reactive lipoyl/dihydrolipoyl residue chemistry, not the model's incompatible full symbolic formulas or all carrier-protein contexts.

official_contract.rhea: RHEA-COMP:10475 and RHEA-COMP:10474 use an unchanged textual [protein] remainder; reactive residues CHEBI:83100 C14H26N2O2S2 and CHEBI:83099 C14H24N2O2S2 differ only by H2.
official_contract.kegg: C02972 C8H16NOS2R and C02051 C8H14NOS2R are the reduced/oxidized lipoyl-bearing H-protein generic pair and differ only by H2.

model_contract.m588: dihydrolipoylprotein C8H15OS2R, charge 0, annotated C02972/MNXM731215; formula is missing N and one H relative to KEGG C02972.
model_contract.m586: lipoylprotein C12H18N2O4S2R2(C2H2NOR)n, charge 0, annotated MNXM1093313/BiGG lprot; no current C02051 xref.
model_contract.symbolic_remainder_test: failed: m588 has one R, whereas m586 has R2 plus a polymer repeat term; the same conserved protein remainder is not algebraically asserted.

moiety_contract.reason: A unilateral xref would identify the oxidized endpoint but would neither repair m588's conflicting C02972 formula nor prove that both model species carry the same conserved protein moiety. KEGG C02051/C02972 also explicitly describe the lipoyl-bearing H protein, so global use across other carrier-protein contexts requires incident-reaction evidence.
minimum_source_close_requirements: Choose one symbolic representation family for both endpoints: KEGG generic moiety pair or Rhea reactive-residue pair.
Use the same declared protein remainder and charge convention on both sides.
Normalize m586 and m588 together with NAD(H) tuples and verify R364 plus every incident reaction atomically.
Require zero new balance regressions and retain the human activation gate.
